keyStrongsNotes: Shir Hama’alot (H7892 + H4609 — Song of Ascents), Ezer (H5828 — Rescuing covenant help from the Creator).

title: Galatians 5:22 — But the Fruit of the Spirit Is Love, Joy, Peace | AduBible.org®
positionZeroSummary: Galatians 5:22–23 details the supernatural character produced by the indwelling Holy Spirit: love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control.
nkjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. Against such there is no law.
kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
bsb: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. Against such things there is no law.
originalLanguageText: Ὁ δὲ καρπὸς τοῦ Πνεύματός ἐστιν ἀγάπη, χαρά, εἰρήνη, μακροθυμία, χρηστότης, ἀγαθωσύνη, πίστις, πρᾳότης, ἐγκράτεια·
twiText: Na Honhom no aba ne ɔdɔ, anigyeɛ, asomdwoeɛ, aboterɛ, ayamyeɛ, papayɛ, gyidie, dwoɔ, ahosuo.
keyStrongsNotes: Karpos (G2590 — Organic mature fruit), Makrothymia (G3115 — Patient endurance), Engkrateia (G1466 — Mastery over fleshly impulses).

title: Ephesians 2:8 — For by Grace You Have Been Saved Through Faith | AduBible.org®
positionZeroSummary: Ephesians 2:8–9 anchors the gospel of unearned justification: "For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast."
nkjv: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast.
kjv: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: not of works, lest any man should boast.
bsb: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God, not by works, so that no one can boast.
originalLanguageText: Τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι διὰ τῆς πίστεως· καὶ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐξ ὑμῶν, Θεοῦ τὸ δῶρον· οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων, ἵνα μή τις καυχήσηται.
twiText: Na adom na wɔnam gyidie so agye mo nkwa; na ɛnyɛ mo na mofiri, Onyankopɔn akyɛdeɛ a;
keyStrongsNotes: Charis (G5485 — Unmerited sovereign favor), Sesōsmenoi (G4982 — Perfect tense: saved permanently with enduring result), Dōron (G1435 — Free unearned gift).

title: 2 Timothy 1:7 — For God Has Not Given Us a Spirit of Fear | AduBible.org®
positionZeroSummary: 2 Timothy 1:7 shatters anxiety and timidity: "For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." Believers are endowed with divine authority, agape, and mental clarity.
nkjv: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.
kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
bsb: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-discipline.
originalLanguageText: Οὐ γὰρ ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν ὁ Θεὸς πνεῦμα δειλίας, ἀλλὰ δυνάμεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ σωφρονισμοῦ.
twiText: Na Onyankopɔn amma yɛn ehu honhom, na mmom tumi ne ɔdɔ ne adwenmu-katee honhom.
keyStrongsNotes: Deilia (G1167 — Cowardice, timidity), Dynamis (G1411 — Divine spiritual power), Sōphronismos (G4995 — Self-disciplined, sane, sound-minded thinking).

title: James 1:5 — If Any of You Lacks Wisdom, Let Him Ask of God | AduBible.org®
positionZeroSummary: James 1:5 is God’s standing invitation to the perplexed: "If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him."
nkjv: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
bsb: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.
originalLanguageText: Εἰ δέ τις ὑμῶν λείπεται σοφίας, αἰτείτω παρὰ τοῦ διδόντος Θεοῦ πᾶσιν ἁπλῶς καὶ μὴ ὀνειδίζοντος, καὶ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ.
twiText: Na sɛ mo mu bi di nyansa nsam a, ɔmmisa Onyankopɔn a ɔma nnipa nyinaa kɛseɛ a ɔnwiinwii no, na wɔbɛma no.
keyStrongsNotes: Sophia (G4678 — Practical insight), Haplōs (G574 — Bountifully without hidden motive), Oneidizō (G3679 — Fault-finding rebuke).

title: 1 Peter 5:7 — Casting All Your Care upon Him, for He Cares for You | AduBible.org®
positionZeroSummary: 1 Peter 5:7 instructs the overwhelmed believer to fling their full burden onto God: "Casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you." God personally tends to every detail of the believer’s welfare.
nkjv: Casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.
kjv: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
bsb: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
originalLanguageText: Πᾶσαν τὴν μέριμναν ὑμῶν ἐπιρρίψαντες ἐπ’ αὐτόν, ὅτι αὐτῷ μέλει περὶ ὑμῶν.
twiText: Monto mo dadwene nyinaa ngu ne so, na ɔno na ɔdwen mo ho.
keyStrongsNotes: Epirriptō (G1977 — Fling or roll a heavy burden onto another’s shoulders), Merimna (G3308 — Fracturing anxiety), Melei (G3199 — It is of deep personal concern to Him).

title: Revelation 21:4 — God Will Wipe Away Every Tear from Their Eyes | AduBible.org®
positionZeroSummary: Revelation 21:4 pictures the eternal redemption of all sorrow: "And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes; there shall be no more death, nor sorrow, nor crying. There shall be no more pain, for the former things have passed away."
nkjv: And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes; there shall be no more death, nor sorrow, nor crying. There shall be no more pain, for the former things have passed away.
kjv: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
bsb: “He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the old order of things has passed away.”
originalLanguageText: Καὶ ἐξαλείψει ὁ Θεὸς πᾶν δάκρυον ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ ὁ θάνατος οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι, οὔτε πένθος οὔτε κραυγὴ οὔτε πόνος οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι, ὅτι τὰ πρῶτα ἀπῆλθον.
twiText: Na ɔbɛprapra nnisuɔ nyinaa afiri wɔn ani so, na owuo nni hɔ bio, na su anaa obubu anaa yea nni hɔ bio; na kane deɛ no atwam kɔ.
keyStrongsNotes: Exaleiphō (G1813 — Erase, obliterate completely), Thanatos (G2288 — Death destroyed forever), Penthos (G3997 — Grief/mourning).

title: Romans 12:2 — Do Not Be Conformed to This World But Be Transformed | AduBible.org®
positionZeroSummary: Romans 12:2 calls for radical cognitive and spiritual sanctification: "Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what is that good and acceptable and perfect will of God."
nkjv: And do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what is that good and acceptable and perfect will of God.
kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
bsb: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
originalLanguageText: Καὶ μὴ συσχηματίζεσθε τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ, ἀλλὰ μεταμορφοῦσθε τῇ ἀνακαινώσει τοῦ νοὸς ὑμῶν, εἰς τὸ δοκιμάζειν ὑμᾶς τί τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸ ἀγαθὸν καὶ εὐάρεστον καὶ τέλειον.
twiText: Na monnsusu wiase yi so, na mmom momfa mo adwene foforɔ no so nsesa mo ho, na moasɔ ahwɛ deɛ ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ a ɛye na ɛsɔ ani na ɛwie pɛyɛ.
keyStrongsNotes: Syschēmatizō (G4964 — Squeezed into the mold of this age), Metamorphoō (G3339 — Inner metamorphosis), Anakainōsis (G342 — Complete qualitative renewal of mind).

title: 2 Chronicles 7:14 — If My People Who Are Called by My Name Will Humble Themselves | AduBible.org®
positionZeroSummary: 2 Chronicles 7:14 outlines God’s covenant conditions for national revival and territorial restoration: humility, earnest prayer, seeking His face, turning from wicked ways, bringing divine forgiveness and healing to the land.
nkjv: If My people who are called by My name will humble themselves, and pray and seek My face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin and heal their land.
kjv: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
bsb: and My people who are called by My name humble themselves, and pray and seek My face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
originalLanguageText: וְיִכָּנְעוּ עַמִּי אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָא־שְׁמִי עֲלֵיהֶם וְיִתְפַּלְלוּ וִיבַקְשׁוּ פָנַי וְיָשֻׁבוּ מִדַּרְכֵיהֶם הָרָעִים וַאֲנִי אֶשְׁמַע מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶסְלַח לְחַטָּאתָם וְאֶרְפָּא אֶת־אַרְצָם׃
twiText: Na me man a wɔfrɛ me din gu wɔn so no brɛ wɔn ho ase, na wɔbɔ mpaeɛ, na wɔhwehwɛ m’anim, na wɔsane firi wɔn akwanbɔne so a, mɛte firi soro, na mede wɔn bɔne bɛfiri wɔn, na masa wɔn asase yareɛ.
keyStrongsNotes: Kana (H3665 — Humble, bow the knee), Baqash (H1245 — Seek with urgent desire), Salach (H5545 — Forgive covenantally), Rapha (H7495 — Heal diseased land).

title: Psalm 119:105 — Your Word Is a Lamp to My Feet and a Light to My Path | AduBible.org®
positionZeroSummary: Psalm 119:105 celebrates the illuminating power of God’s Word: "Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path." It guides immediate daily steps and illuminates the overarching life trajectory.
nkjv: Your word is a lamp to my feet And a light to my path.
kjv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
bsb: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
originalLanguageText: נֵר־לְרַגְלִי דְבָרֶךָ וְאוֹר לִנְתִיבָתִי׃
twiText: W’asɛm yɛ me nan ase kanea, ne me kwan so hann.
keyStrongsNotes: Ner (H5216 — Oil lamp shedding immediate circle of light), Dabar (H1697 — Divine spoken revelation), Or (H216 — Brilliant morning light), Nativah (H5410 — Long beaten path).
